core_obligations: Write down the cartesian diagram comparing W_Y -> P^1_Y -> Y with W -> P^1_X -> X and identify W_infinity x_X Y with W_{Y,infinity} (proof lines 10163-10176).

For alpha in CH_k(X) choose beta in CH_{k+1}(W) restricting to the flat pullback of alpha on b^{-1}(A^1_X), and note that c cap beta restricts to the flat pullback of c cap alpha on b_Y^{-1}(A^1_Y), which is what makes c cap beta an admissible choice for the base changed situation (proof lines 10177-10181).

Conclude the identity: since c is a bivariant class, i_{Y,infinity}^*(c cap beta) = c cap i_infinity^* beta, which says precisely C cap c cap alpha = c cap C cap alpha, and repeat the argument after any base change by X' -> X locally of finite type (proof lines 10181-10188).
proof_roadmap: Set up the cartesian diagram of the two Gysin-at-infinity constructions (proof lines 10163-10176).
Produce compatible beta for alpha and for c cap alpha (proof lines 10177-10181).
Use bivariance to exchange c with i_{Y,infinity}^* and conclude, base change included (proof lines 10181-10188).
difficulty_reason: Extending the Gysin-at-infinity lemma, the statement says that for a morphism f : Y -> X locally of finite type and a class c in A^*(Y -> X), the class C of that lemma satisfies C o c = c o C in A^*(W_infinity x_X Y -> X) (statement lines 10155-10160). The proof builds the full cartesian diagram of W_Y over W over P^1_Y over Y and W_Y over P^1_X over X, picks beta in CH_{k+1}(W) restricting to the flat pullback of alpha on b^{-1}(A^1_X), observes that c cap beta restricts to the flat pullback of c cap alpha on b_Y^{-1}(A^1_Y), and then compares i_{Y,infinity}^*(c cap beta) with c cap i_infinity^* beta using that c is a bivariant class; this is exactly the identity C cap c cap alpha = c cap C cap alpha, and the same argument repeats after any base change by X' -> X locally of finite type (proof lines 10163-10188). Matching the two compatibilities, one for the class c and one for the defining property of C, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
